spans.s:
ind.
Here here, come here.
E.
इतस् repeated.

Obtained.
E.
इण to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone.
E.
ई to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Other, different.
2 Low, vile.
E.
इ desire, तृ to pass over, and अप् aff.

ind.
In another manner, otherwise, differently.
E.
था added to इतर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Mutual, one with another. Respective, several.
E.
इतर repeated.

f. (-म्या)
Respective or several fancies or inclinations.
E.
इतरेतर and काम्य to be desired.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Affecting or concerning mutually.
E.
इतरेतर and आश्रय object or receptacle.

ind.
Another or different day.
E.
इतर and एद्यस् aff.

ind.
Hence, from hence.
E.
irr. deriv. from इदम् this, with तसिल् aff.

ind.
Here and there, hither and thither.
E.
इतस् hence, ततस् thence.

ind.
Hither and thither.
E.
इतस् repeated, with च and, inserted.
